Best Italian food I've had in south east Asia...
Mar 2026 • Solo
Genuinely the best Italian food and English breakfast I've had in the whole of sea, which I've been travelling since 2019. I had the carbonara, English breakfast, fruit bowl and a couple other dishes as ive been back a couple times now. I also had an egg coffee and salt coffee, both really well done. Everything well presented and delicious...the quality of the food made me feel like a high-end restaurant. Service was great too. Hanh, the owner, was friendly, polite and attentive. I look forward to going back and trying their other Italian dishes. Highly recommended, especially if you enjoy Italian dishes and great coffee.
